nodes.rationale: Specifies background, text, brand, and status colors with 4px grid spacing scale and spring motion curves.

nodes.label: Design Token Anarchy & Cyber-Gamer Aesthetics
nodes.rationale: Conflicting palettes between tokens.css and app.css, gaudy pulsating neon effects causing visual fatigue, and non-Retina canvas charts.

nodes.label: Colorblind-Safe Multimodal Status Feedback
nodes.rationale: Pairs color coding with distinct text labels, icons, positions, and glows so states are distinguishable in grayscale.

nodes.label: Mathematically Invalid Excel Aggregation Formula
nodes.rationale: Calculating AVERAGE() across minute averages distorts daily scores because minutes have varying sample counts.

nodes.label: Python Heap Memory Aggregation Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Loading 50,000+ rows into Python memory and doing manual loops instead of utilizing SQL GROUP BY and AVG aggregation.

nodes.label: Data Retention & Excel Reporting Policy
nodes.rationale: Retain granular minute summaries for 35 days and aggregate daily summaries for 365 days to maintain historical stats while minimizing storage.

nodes.label: Pre-Handoff Build Artifact Cleanup Policy
nodes.rationale: Mandates removing node_modules, dist, and pycache caches before creating zip archives or delivering project handoffs.
